segments.name: Advertising
segments.description: Sells performance-based advertising and subscription products to local businesses of all sizes, connecting them with Yelp's high-intent consumer audience.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it has a single operating and reporting segment managed on a consolidated basis.

revenueModel.text: Businesses of all sizes pay Yelp for targeted performance-based advertising and subscription page products that reach its high-intent consumer audience.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily sell performance-based ads, which our advertising platform matches to individual consumers through our automated auction system priced on a CPC basis.

changes.text: In 2025 the company recast prior period segment information to conform to how it internally managed and monitored its business.
changes.evidence: Prior period segment information has been recast to conform to the way the Company internally managed and monitored its business during 2025.
